description: Fake data generator with rule-based configuration.

A Blazor component for providing a self-positioning FlyoutMenu (popover) triggered from a kebab button or a custom trigger element, with collision-aware placement, data-driven or templated items, and full keyboard accessibility.

Component tests for Telegram bots built on Bladehero.Telegram.Platform: runs the bot's real long-polling or webhook hosting against an in-memory Bot API that answers and records every request, with test users who send messages and files and tap buttons — no Telegram needed.
Activation window and start-up gate for WPF apps licensed through redskia.dev. Frontend only: the validator is RedSkia.Licensing.
Licence activation and offline ES256 token verification for software sold on redskia.dev. No dependencies.

Self-contained neural network library for .NET: tensors, autograd, layers and optimizers with a SIMD CPU backend and a CUDA backend that talks to the NVIDIA driver directly. No TensorFlow, no native dependencies.
ASP.NET Core integration for Idrak: registers an InferenceEngine in dependency injection and maps prediction, generation, Ollama-compatible chat and status endpoints.

Datasets for Idrak (no dependencies): read JSON Lines, JSON, CSV, text and Parquet files, archives and compressed files; download and cache from URLs, Hugging Face, GitHub, Kaggle and Zenodo; filter, map, shuffle, deduplicate, split, mix and turn rows into chat transcripts for fine-tuning.

idrak-data: inspect, count, download and assemble training datasets from Hugging Face, GitHub, Kaggle, Zenodo, URLs and local files (JSON Lines, JSON, CSV, text, code, Parquet) into JSON Lines any tool can read.
idrak-tune: fine-tune pretrained language models (LoRA / QLoRA) on any dataset idrak-data reads, evaluate them, chat with them and export them; one tool for every fine-tuning job.

Language models for Idrak (no dependencies): load Llama, Qwen, Mistral and Gemma models by Hugging Face id, folder or GGUF file (safetensors and quantized GGUF weights, an extensible architecture registry), with their own BPE tokenizers and chat templates; chat with them, fine-tune them (LoRA / QLo…
Model Context Protocol for Idrak: use the tools of MCP servers in conversations and the inference engine, and serve Idrak tools to MCP clients.
ONNX export for Idrak models (no dependencies): networks become .onnx files that ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, OpenVINO, DirectML and other runtimes can run.
Runs ONNX models (exported by Idrak.Onnx or any other tool) with ONNX Runtime as Idrak modules, so they work with predictors, the inference engine and the ASP.NET Core endpoints.
Base infrastructure for the Polhem framework, including collections, serialization, encryption, and general-purpose utilities.
Tallyman counts lines in every file under a directory.
.NET client for Omron NX/NJ Sysmac controllers over EtherNet/IP (symbolic tag access). C# port of the omron-eip Node.js library, plus a high-throughput multi-session API.
